summary: A new water connection requires registration on the municipal portal, submission of ownership and identity documents, payment of connection charges, and inspection before activation. Typically 7–20 working days.

steps.title: Register on the municipal services portal
steps.description: Create an account on the Municipal Corporation Chandigarh online services portal using a valid mobile number and email address. Registration is free and immediate.

steps.title: Prepare identity and ownership documents
steps.description: Collect proof of identity (Aadhaar/PAN), proof of address, and ownership documents for the premises requiring the connection.

steps.title: Fill the online application form
steps.description: Log in to the portal, select the New Water Connection service, and complete the application form with premises details, applicant details, and connection size.

steps.title: Upload documents
steps.description: Upload scanned copies of all required documents in PDF or JPG format, each under 2 MB, as listed on the application form.

steps.title: Pay connection charges online
steps.description: Pay the applicable connection charges via net banking, UPI, debit or credit card. Charges vary by connection size; the portal shows the exact amount before payment.

steps.title: Schedule and attend site inspection
steps.description: The department conducts a site inspection to verify premises details. Use the application reference number to track inspection scheduling on the portal.

steps.title: Receive connection activation
steps.description: Once approved and inspected, the water connection is activated and confirmation is sent by SMS to the registered mobile number.

warnings: Connection charges vary by pipe size and locality. Verify the exact amount on the official portal.
